summary: Completed testing of Meal Builder feature - both backend API and frontend UI. All 15 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend tests verified all requested features working correctly.

minor.issue: Backend accepts empty meal names and empty foods arrays - validation is frontend-only

issues: ESLint warning: useEffect missing dependency 'handleSearch' in MealBuilder.jsx line 71 - cosmetic, not affecting functionality

passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/custom-meals creates meal with correct structure
Backend: Meal creation calculates total macros correctly from foods
Backend: Keto tier calculation works for ultra_low/low/moderate/high tiers
Backend: GET /api/custom-meals returns user's meals list
Backend: DELETE /api/custom-meals/{id} removes meal correctly
Backend: DELETE nonexistent meal returns 404
Backend: Food search API works for meal builder (returns fdc_id, description, protein, calories)
Backend: Food details API works for accurate macros
Backend: POST /api/custom-meals/{id}/log logs all foods from meal
Backend: Log nonexistent meal returns 404
Backend: Create/get meals require authentication
Frontend: Meal Builder page loads at /meal-builder route
Frontend: Meal name input field works
Frontend: Add Food button opens search modal
Frontend: Food search returns results from backend (debounce 300ms working)
Frontend: Clicking food result adds it to meal with toast notification
Frontend: Total macros update correctly when foods added
Frontend: Portion controls (+/- buttons and input) work correctly
Frontend: Portion changes update macros (100g->150g: 224cal->336cal)
Frontend: Delete food button removes item from meal
Frontend: Save Meal button creates meal via POST /api/custom-meals
Frontend: Save redirects to dashboard with 'Meal saved!' toast
Frontend: Validation - Save button disabled without meal name or foods
critical_code_review_comments: MealBuilder.jsx: useEffect on line 71 has missing handleSearch dependency - recommend adding to deps or wrapping in useCallback
Backend validation is minimal - frontend handles name/food validation but backend accepts empty arrays
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed custom meals created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Meal Builder feature fully tested and working. Key data-testids: meal-name-input, add-food-btn, search-food-input, search-result-{n}, meal-food-{n}, portion-input-{n}, remove-food-{n}, save-meal-btn, total-calories, total-protein, total-fat, total-carbs. Note: Playwright fill() works for React controlled inputs (not keyboard.type). Search modal has 300ms debounce before API call.
